# API Endpoints — `server.js`

> HTTP wrapper for the **Judge AI Dredd** test runner. Listens on port **3000** (ALB-compatible).
> Source: `/app/server.js`

---

## Summary

| # | Method | Path             | Purpose                                                  |
|---|--------|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | GET    | `/`              | Health check + HTML status dashboard                     |
| 2 | GET    | `/favicon.ico`   | Serves the site favicon                                  |
| 3 | GET    | `/status`        | JSON snapshot of current run state                       |
| 4 | GET    | `/logs`          | Plain-text tail of the run's log buffer                  |
| 5 | GET    | `/files`         | Lists files under `/app/runs/`                           |
| 6 | GET    | `/files/<name>`  | Fetches a single file from `/app/runs/`                  |
| 7 | POST   | `/run`           | Starts a new batch run                                   |
| 8 | POST   | `/stop`          | Terminates the currently running process                 |

Any other path returns **404** with a JSON error body.

---

## Endpoint Details

### 1. `GET /`
**Description:** Health check endpoint required by the AWS ALB. Always returns **200 OK** with an HTML status page that renders:
- Current run status (`idle` / `running` / `done` / `failed`) as a coloured badge
- Build version, run ID, start/finish timestamps, exit code, PID
- Progress: completed / total combinations, failed count, completed reps, last GES value
- The last 100 lines of buffered log output

**Response:** `text/html; charset=utf-8`, `Cache-Control: no-store`

---

### 2. `GET /favicon.ico`
**Description:** Serves the favicon from `/app/src/web/favicon.ico`. Returns **404** if the file isn't present.

**Response:** `image/x-icon` with a 1-day cache header on success.

---
